component.name: typo3-demo
component.description: External services this instance talks to. Hand-maintained: no scanner can derive it, because it is about what the running site calls rather than what its images contain. The pull-based ingest on the Dependency-Track host fetches this file from the default branch and injects it into the stack BOM. Measured before writing: the front page loads no third-party resource at all — every script, style and image comes from the instance itself, and the twitter/facebook/youtube occurrences in the markup are plain links, not requests.

services.name: OpenAI API
services.description: The one external call this demo makes. EXT:nr_llm sends prompts server-side for the chat, vision and embedding features the instance showcases; the API key lives in EXT:nr_vault, never in the image. Which provider is configured is a backend setting — api.openai.com is what the shipped seed carries, and the extension is provider-agnostic.
